description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Array', a data preprocessor for the Image_Graph package that maps numerical data to array-based labels, used in graph rendering.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Array
classes.description: A class that formats data by mapping numerical values to labels using an array, facilitating data representation in graphs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the data array used for mapping.

methods.name: _process
methods.description: Processes a value by returning its mapped label if available, otherwise returns the original value.
